nodes.norm_label: decision: prefer same-window attribution summaries over post-window f11 solo
nodes.rationale: The attribution entries collected during the Ctrl+F10 window are the authoritative evidence because the camera/object/material state is still the one the user aimed at.

nodes.label: Decision: Add shader/resource attribution packets
nodes.rationale: Cbuffer-size and route-family identities are too broad for individual shader issues. The next selector should be keyed by shader/resource identity.

nodes.norm_label: decision: pivot full-eye presentation to openxr-sized native eye targets
nodes.rationale: More crop/blit calibration cannot become full-frame VR because the private eye producer is still rendering at the game HDR extent.

nodes.label: Decision: Treat UnrealPort as an offline RE reference
nodes.norm_label: decision: treat unrealport as an offline re reference
nodes.rationale: The repository is dominated by T3D map exports and conversion batches. It contains no D3D, OpenXR, stereo-view, or camera-hook implementation.
